$comment: Parameter metadata ground truth for CADET-GUI. Only `unit`/`description`/`source` (+ each model's parameter order) are hand-curated here -- CADET-Process itself never carries a parameter's physical unit or a human description (confirmed: nothing in CADETProcess.processModel sets the `unit=`/`description=` kwargs its own ParameterBase accepts), so CADET-Core's docs are the only source for those. Everything else this file used to also hand-type -- component_dependent, dtype, min/max, co_name, default, required_parameters, and each model's CADET-Core type name (co_unit_type/co_model_name, which duplicated unit_parameters_map[model]['name']/adsorption_parameters_map[model]['name'] verbatim) -- is now read live off the real CADET-Process descriptor/object + CADETProcess.simulator.cadetAdapter's own parameter maps by cadetgui/parameters/__init__.py -- see that module's docstring. `co_name` always follows CADET-Process's own naming (the live-derived code variant); four cases where CADET-Core's docs use a different name are tracked in ai-docs/UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md #5, not duplicated here as a per-parameter override -- once co_name is live, there's no code left for a doc-variant name to override. GUI-layer decisions (which fields to render, how) still belong in cadetprocessadapter.py, not here. Sourced from CADET-Core/doc/interface/{binding,unit_operations,solver.rst} and CADET-Process's CADETProcess/processModel/{binding,unitOperation}.py + CADETProcess/simulator/cadetAdapter.py, verified 2026-09-07/2026-09-23 -- no invented units/ranges.

column.$comment: Shared TubularReactorBase parameters (length/diameter/axial_dispersion) apply to GeneralRateModel, LumpedRateModelWithPores, LumpedRateModelWithoutPores -- NOT Cstr, which has a different base class and volume-based geometry instead.

length.source: interface/unit_operations/axial_flow_column_1D_config.rst BED_LENGTH -- CADET-Process's own unit_parameters_map instead writes COL_LENGTH (the live-derived co_name) for this attribute; see ai-docs/UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md #5 for the doc/code name mismatch.

diameter.description: Column diameter (converted to cross-section area before reaching CADET-Core).
diameter.source: CADETProcess/processModel/unitOperation.py TubularReactorBase.cross_section_area; interface/unit_operations/axial_flow_column_1D_config.rst CROSS_SECTION_AREA (unit m^2, range >0). diameter itself has no co_name -- it never appears in unit_parameters_map (confirmed), only the derived cross_section_area does.

film_diffusion.description: Film diffusion coefficient (mass transfer through the particle film) per component.

pore_diffusion.description: Effective pore diffusion coefficient per component.
pore_diffusion.source: interface/unit_operations/particle_config.rst PORE_DIFFUSION -- CADET-Process's own unit_parameters_map instead writes PAR_DIFFUSION (the live-derived co_name) for GeneralRateModel; see ai-docs/UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md #5 for the doc/code name mismatch.

c.description: Initial concentration in the bulk mobile phase, per component.
c.source: interface/unit_operations/axial_flow_column_1D_config.rst INIT_C; CADET-Process's unit_parameters_map maps INIT_C -> c the same way for every column model, including Cstr.

cp.description: Initial concentration in the particle liquid (pore) phase, per component. Only meaningful for models with an explicit particle pore phase (GRM, LRMP).

q.description: Initial concentration in the solid (bound) phase, per component. Stays unset (None, hidden) until a real binding model -- not NoBinding -- actually gives the column bound states.
q.source: interface/unit_operations/particle_config.rst INIT_CS -- CADET-Process's own unit_parameters_map instead writes INIT_Q (the live-derived co_name) for every column model; see ai-docs/UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md #5 for the doc/code name mismatch.

pore_accessibility.description: Fraction of pore volume accessible to each component (defaults to 1, i.e. fully accessible). Only meaningful for models with a particle pore phase (GRM, LRMP); CADET-Core's own docs say not to combine this with a binding model.

surface_diffusion.description: Particle surface diffusion coefficient per bound state of each component. Only applied when CADET-Core's HAS_SURFACE_DIFFUSION flag is set, which the GUI doesn't currently expose -- this stays unset (None, hidden) here.
surface_diffusion.source: interface/unit_operations/particle_config.rst SURFACE_DIFFUSION -- CADET-Process's own unit_parameters_map instead writes PAR_SURFDIFFUSION (the live-derived co_name) for GeneralRateModel; see ai-docs/UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md #5 for the doc/code name mismatch.

flow_direction.description: Flow direction: 1 = forward, -1 = backward. CADET-Process's own Switch descriptor only accepts these two exact values (bounds are live-derived from `Switch.valid` rather than a Ranged lb/ub); the bounded numeric field this renders as doesn't restrict entries to just them, same as any other min/max-bounded field -- CADET-Process's setter still rejects anything else on assignment.
flow_direction.source: CADETProcess/processModel/unitOperation.py TubularReactorBase.flow_direction = Switch(valid=[-1, 1], default=1); interface/unit_operations/axial_flow_column_1D_config.rst VELOCITY (the field this sign is ultimately applied to).

total_porosity.description: Total porosity (bed + particle combined into one lumped value; there are no explicit particles in this model).

axial_dispersion.description: Axial dispersion coefficient for this tubing/mixer segment. CADET-Process's own descriptor is component-dependent here too (same SizedUnsignedList as a real column, confirmed directly) -- cadetprocessadapter.py's `_FORCE_SCALAR` overrides it to render as a single scalar with no multiplex toggle, since this is a dead-volume element, not chemistry-carrying column geometry. A GUI-layer decision, so it lives in code, not this file.
axial_dispersion.source: CADETProcess/simulator/cadetAdapter.py unit_parameters_map['TubularReactor'] maps this unit type to CADET-Core's LUMPED_RATE_MODEL_WITHOUT_PORES, same COL_DISPERSION field as a real column; interface/unit_operations/axial_flow_column_1D_config.rst COL_DISPERSION.

init_liquid_volume.description: Initial liquid volume in the tank.

flow_rate_filter.description: Flow rate of pure liquid (no components) leaving through the CSTR's filter, on top of its regular outlet flow.

const_solid_volume.description: Fixed solid-phase volume in the tank, for binding in a CSTR.

binding.$comment: No shared_parameters section: unlike column models, the same CADET-Process attribute name (e.g. capacity) means a genuinely different thing per binding model -- for Langmuir it is per-component (length NCOMP), for StericMassAction it is a single scalar (length 1). Live introspection off each model's own real descriptor already gets this right automatically (see cadetgui/parameters/__init__.py); sharing curated text across models would still risk misrepresenting one of them, which is exactly the bug this file exists to avoid (see cadetgui's PARAM_SCHEMA / REQUIREMENTS.md item #12).

is_kinetic.description: Kinetic (true) vs. quasi-stationary/rapid-equilibrium (false) adsorption. Not in CADET-Process's own required_parameters (it has a non-None default, True), so it never auto-renders -- build_parameter_config_spec adds it explicitly for binding models with a real isotherm.

adsorption_rate.description: Adsorption rate constant. Unit differs from Linear/StericMassAction's adsorption_rate (mol-based here, volume-based there) -- do not share one definition across binding models.

capacity.description: Maximum adsorption capacity, per component. Unlike StericMassAction.capacity (a single scalar shared by all components), Langmuir's capacity is genuinely per-component -- live-derived component_dependent already tells the two apart automatically since they're different real descriptors. CADET-Core's own docs require this strictly positive; CADET-Process's descriptor itself only forbids negative values (allows exactly 0), so this is one physical constraint that can't be read off the live bound alone.

is_kinetic.description: Kinetic (true) vs. quasi-stationary/rapid-equilibrium (false) adsorption. Not in CADET-Process's own required_parameters (it has a non-None default, True), so it never auto-renders -- build_parameter_config_spec adds it explicitly for binding models with a real isotherm.

characteristic_charge.description: Characteristic charge (nu): number of resin sites the protein interacts with.

steric_factor.description: Steric factor (sigma): number of resin sites shielded by the bound protein.

capacity.description: Stationary phase (ionic) capacity -- a single value shared by the whole resin, not per component. Unlike Langmuir.capacity (per-component), this is a scalar (length 1) -- live-derived component_dependent already tells the two apart automatically since they're different real descriptors.

is_kinetic.description: Kinetic (true) vs. quasi-stationary/rapid-equilibrium (false) adsorption. Not in CADET-Process's own required_parameters (it has a non-None default, True), so it never auto-renders -- build_parameter_config_spec adds it explicitly for binding models with a real isotherm.

reference_liquid_phase_conc.description: Reference liquid phase concentration, used to normalize the adsorption term.

reference_solid_phase_conc.description: Reference solid phase concentration, used to normalize the desorption term.

solver.$comment: Not yet exposed anywhere in the GUI (REQUIREMENTS.md 'Next widgets' #8) -- populated here as the third category the product owner asked to distinguish, and to prove the schema (and now live introspection) generalizes beyond column/binding. Global per-simulation settings, none are component-dependent. No co_name here -- CADETProcess.simulator.cadetAdapter has no cp_name<->co_name map for this class (it writes a plain-uppercase HDF5 group instead), unlike unit_parameters_map/adsorption_parameters_map for column/binding. `co_group` stays hand-typed -- it names a path in CADET-Python's H5 wrapper tree (input.solver.time_integrator), which isn't stored as an introspectable string anywhere in CADET-Process, unlike co_name.

abstol.description: Absolute tolerance in the solution of the original system.

reltol.description: Relative tolerance in the solution of the original system.

algtol.description: Tolerance in the solution of the nonlinear consistency equations.

reltol_sens.description: Relative tolerance in the solution of the sensitivity systems.

init_step_size.description: Initial time integrator step size (0.0: IDAS default).

max_steps.description: Maximum number of timesteps taken by IDAS (0: IDAS default = 500).

max_step_size.description: Maximum size of timesteps taken by IDAS (0.0: unlimited).

errortest_sens.description: Whether (forward) sensitivities take part in the local error test.

max_newton_iter.description: Maximum number of Newton iterations per time step.

max_errtest_fail.description: Maximum number of local error test failures per time step.

max_convtest_fail.description: Maximum number of Newton convergence test failures per time step.

max_newton_iter_sens.description: Maximum number of Newton iterations in the forward sensitivity time step.
